description:
Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0

This release is the English-only OC Core 1.3 public package for Zenodo archival deposit.

The primary scientific artifact is the English LaTeX-derived master monograph rebuilt from the public source corpus. The upload set is curated by OC_CORE_1_3_ZENODO_EN_ONLY_MANIFEST.json and staged by the repository helper.

Russian and German translation work is preserved in the repository as deferred Core 1.3.1 draft material, but it is not part of this Zenodo 1.3 upload and is not release-blocking for the English package.

The English master monograph carries explicit front matter, reader guidance, a theorem roadmap, worked examples, reviewer-navigation appendices, figures, and the Core 1.3 foundational consistency dossier inside the outward scholarly artifact itself.

A separate English Journal Core extraction provides the shorter editorial route.

The scientific body stays aligned with the audited Core 1.2 public source corpus while explicitly adding the Core 1.3 source-audit, theorem-fate, chronology, and publication-boundary layers.
notes: Prepared from the OC Core 1.3 source-first package. The Zenodo 1.3 upload lane is English-only and is curated by OC_CORE_1_3_ZENODO_EN_ONLY_MANIFEST.json. Russian and German translations are deferred to Core 1.3.1 review. The monograph includes the theorem roadmap, worked examples, reviewer-navigation appendix, and the Core 1.3 foundational consistency dossier.
title: Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0
